comparison.objective: Candidate removes a fan only; record removes a spent coin cell and installs and latches a replacement.
comparison.physical_skill: Bracket-held vertical module withdrawal versus millimetric latch deflection, disc extraction, polarity-aware insertion under a hook, and snap latching.
comparison.success_condition: Fan removed and placed for 3 s versus spent cell in tray plus new cell aligned, + side up, latched, released, and still for 1 s, with short/drop vetoes.
comparison.reason: The replacement task tests fine insertion, polarity, and completed re-latching, substantially beyond a removal-only sequence.
